verdict.rationale: Docs describe a `live_view_url`/live preview that lets a human take control mid-run at CAPTCHA or 2FA checkpoints, explicitly framed as 'human control' and 'human checkpoint' fallback, and sessions can continue after human intervention. This directly matches watching live and taking control when the agent is stuck, though evidence is limited to specific stuck scenarios (captcha/2FA) rather than arbitrary stuck states, and there's no independent/hands-on confirmation of the live-view UI itself. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the live-view UI, evidence of general (non-captcha/2FA) stuck-state handoff, and a demo of resuming full agent control after human takeover.
